title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.32
exact_target: Can the two sharp borderline bounds on continuity and second differences be attained simultaneously by a singular increasing function, for every prescribed slowly diverging factor?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2307032 (AMR-022-7032). CC BY4.0.
